question: Please calculate the average levels of anxiety and depression symptoms from the weekly country data for the United States during the periods from January 1, 2019, to January 1, 2020, and from January 1, 2020, to January 1, 2021. Then, compute the percentage increase in these average symptom levels from the 2019 period to the 2020 period.
sql:
SELECT 
  'United States' as country,
  AVG(CASE WHEN date >= '2019-01-01' AND date < '2020-01-01' THEN CAST(symptom_anxiety AS FLOAT64) ELSE NULL END) as avg_anxiety_2019,
  AVG(CASE WHEN date >= '2019-01-01' AND date < '2020-01-01' THEN CAST(symptom_depression AS FLOAT64) ELSE NULL END) as avg_depression_2019,
  AVG(CASE WHEN date >= '2020-01-01' AND date < '2021-01-01' THEN CAST(symptom_anxiety AS FLOAT64) ELSE NULL END) as avg_anxiety_2020,
  AVG(CASE WHEN date >= '2020-01-01' AND date < '2021-01-01' THEN CAST(symptom_depression AS FLOAT64) ELSE NULL END) as avg_depression_2020,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    AVG(CASE WHEN date >= '2020-01-01' AND date < '2021-01-01' THEN CAST(symptom_anxiety AS FLOAT64) ELSE NULL END) - 
    AVG(CASE WHEN date >= '2019-01-01' AND date < '2020-01-01' THEN CAST(symptom_anxiety AS FLOAT64) ELSE NULL END),
    AVG(CASE WHEN date >= '2019-01-01' AND date < '2020-01-01' THEN CAST(symptom_anxiety AS FLOAT64) ELSE NULL END)
  ) * 100 as pct_increase_anxiety,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    AVG(CASE WHEN date >= '2020-01-01' AND date < '2021-01-01' THEN CAST(symptom_depression AS FLOAT64) ELSE NULL END) - 
    AVG(CASE WHEN date >= '2019-01-01' AND date < '2020-01-01' THEN CAST(symptom_depression AS FLOAT64) ELSE NULL END),
    AVG(CASE WHEN date >= '2019-01-01' AND date < '2020-01-01' THEN CAST(symptom_depression AS FLOAT64) ELSE NULL END)
  ) * 100 as pct_increase_depression
FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_symptom_search.symptom_search_country_weekly`
WHERE country_region = 'United States'
  AND (
    (date >= '2019-01-01' AND date < '2020-01-01') 
    OR 
    (date >= '2020-01-01' AND date < '2021-01-01')
  )
